erros.devolutiva: Usar linguagem clara: 'todo = todos os seus highlighters'; calcular 2 × 5 = 10 explicitamente

erros.devolutiva: Relacionar visualmente a fração com a coleção total: desenhar 10 highlighters, marcar 9 emprestados, mostrar que isso cabe em [0,1]

dicas.texto: Boa pergunta! Quando queremos mostrar 'quantas partes foram usadas do total', que número vai em cima e qual vai embaixo na fração?
Você está no caminho certo! Primeiro, descubra o total de marcadores (2 pacotes × 5). Depois, veja quantos foram emprestados. O total vira o denominador, e o emprestado vira o numerador.
Quase lá! O total de marcadores é um número redondo entre 5 e 15. Quantos são exatamente? Use isso como denominador.
Você está muito perto! Se cada pacote tem 5 e são 2 pacotes, o total é 10. Se emprestou 9, então a fração é 9 sobre... quanto?
Como você dividiria a reta de 0 a 1 em 10 partes iguais? Onde ficaria a nona parte?
Você está indo bem! Imagine a reta dividida em 10 partes. Comece do 0 e conte 9 passos pequenos até chegar perto do 1.
Quase lá! A fração 9/10 está bem perto do 1, mas não exatamente nele. Faltando só um 'pedacinho' para chegar ao fim.
Você está muito perto! Pense: se 10/10 é o 1, então 9/10 é um pouquinho antes. Marque quase no final da reta, mas não exatamente em 1.

misconceptions.feedback: You used the size of one pack as the whole. The denominator must include both packs.

misconceptions.description: Confunde contagem de grupos com contagem de itens
misconceptions.feedback: You counted the groups instead of the highlighters. The denominator counts every highlighter in the collection.

misconceptions.description: Aluno troca mentalmente numerador e denominador
misconceptions.feedback: You used the borrowed part as the denominator. The denominator must represent the entire collection.

misconceptions.description: Aluno adiciona em vez de multiplicar ao encontrar o total
misconceptions.feedback: You added the number of packs to the number in one pack. Equal groups are combined by multiplying the two quantities.

nodes.description: Type the borrowed quantity into field f1, the top fraction box.
nodes.instruction: Type the borrowed quantity into field f1, the top fraction box.

hints.message: The top number of a fraction represents the selected part of the whole.
Locate the quantity that describes the highlighters borrowed and place it in the top field.
Do not enter the number left over; enter the quantity that went to the friend.
Read the borrowed quantity in the statement and type that number into f1.

misconceptions.description: Aluno confunde 'o que foi emprestado' com 'o que restou'
misconceptions.feedback: That value represents what remained. Field f1 must contain the number of highlighters borrowed.

nodes.description: Type the entire collection into field f2, the bottom fraction box.
nodes.instruction: Type the entire collection into field f2, the bottom fraction box.

hints.message: The bottom number tells how many equal parts make the whole.
Calculate the collection total from the two equal packs.
Use both packs and count all their highlighters together.
Multiply the number of packs by the number in each pack, then type that total into f2.

misconceptions.description: Aluno ignora que há dois pacotes e usa o tamanho de um como todo
misconceptions.feedback: You used one pack instead of the entire collection. Both packs must be included.

misconceptions.description: Confunde contagem de grupos com contagem de itens
misconceptions.feedback: You entered the number of packs, but f2 counts highlighters in the whole collection.

misconceptions.description: Aluno troca mentalmente numerador e denominador
misconceptions.feedback: You placed the borrowed part in the denominator. The denominator represents the full collection.

misconceptions.description: Aluno adiciona em vez de multiplicar ao encontrar o total
misconceptions.feedback: You combined the pack count and the pack size incorrectly. Multiply the two equal-group quantities.

nodes.description: Manipulate the fraction model to show that the borrowed part is less than the whole.
nodes.instruction: Manipulate the fraction model to show that the borrowed part is less than the whole.

hints.message: Compare the part with the whole before deciding whether the fraction is below or above 1.
A fraction is less than 1 when its numerator is smaller than its denominator.
The borrowed amount does not use the entire collection; one highlighter remains.
Compare the top number with the bottom number and manipulate the model toward the less-than-one state.

misconceptions.description: Aluno não reconhece que a fração de uma parte de um todo deve ser <1
misconceptions.feedback: A fraction is greater than 1 only when the part is larger than the whole. Here the borrowed amount is smaller than the full collection.

misconceptions.description: Aluno perde totalmente a referência do que é parte e o que é todo
misconceptions.feedback: The part and whole were reversed. The borrowed amount belongs on top, while the entire collection belongs on the bottom.

nodes.description: Mark the point for the fraction on the number line from 0 to 1.
nodes.instruction: Mark the point for the fraction on the number line from 0 to 1.

hints.message: Think about how many equal parts of the interval from 0 to 1 are represented.
Divide the distance from 0 to 1 into the number of equal parts named by the denominator.
Starting at 0, move to the ninth equal division, just before 1.
Count nine of the ten equal intervals from the left endpoint and place the point at that location.

misconceptions.description: Aluno interpreta 9/5 como se fosse 9/10 ou arredonda para dentro do intervalo [0,1], posicionando perto de 1
misconceptions.feedback: The point is one division too far left. Count nine of the ten equal parts to locate the borrowed fraction.

misconceptions.description: Aluno não reconhece que frações impróprias não pertencem a [0,1] e força a entrada
misconceptions.feedback: The point should be just before 1 because one part of the collection was not borrowed.

misconceptions.description: Aluno não distingue entre 1/2, 3/4, 9/10 — todos são 'quase tudo', então coloca perto de 0.5 ou 0.75 arbitrariamente
misconceptions.feedback: The halfway point represents five of ten parts. Nine of ten parts is much closer to 1.

misconceptions.description: Aluno corrige implicitamente o erro do denominador ao posicionar, usando a escala da reta (10 partes)
misconceptions.feedback: The point does not match the number of borrowed parts. Count the equal divisions carefully from zero.

nodes.description: Click Convert to open the mixed-number fields for this fraction.
nodes.instruction: Click Convert to open the mixed-number fields for this fraction.

hints.message: A mixed-number conversion checks whether the fraction contains a complete whole.
Use the conversion control to rewrite the fraction in the form provided by the interface.
Because the numerator is smaller than the denominator, expect no complete whole before the fractional part.
Press the Convert button, then inspect the newly opened whole-number and fractional fields.
